summary: The live risk is rates. October CPI ran hot on 11-10 (+0.4% m/m, core +0.3%), the 10-year touched 5% and the 2-year rose 17bp. Bank of America and others now say a 50bp hike on Dec 9 is possible, so TLT, IEF, BND, VNQ, GLD and BTC all sit under one macro shock, and BTC slid to about $73K. Among single names, TTEK reports today and WMT's approximate 11-19 date enters the 5-trading-day window tomorrow. New items: a 5.02 at BLBD, an unconfirmed takeover rumor on CLX and an activist stake with a board seat at LRN. Held single names (WMT, KR, DPZ, IDXX, CARG, MSM, FAST) have no 4.01, 4.02, 5.02 or 1.01/2.01 filings in the 7-day window. Per lesson L2, I covered every symbol in the events file from its own estimate and filings.

event_risk.why: Continues the 11-10 CPI flag. Benzinga says the hot print pushed the 10-year to 5% and the 2-year up 17bp, and that TLT slid. BofA (11-10) says the Fed may be falling behind and a 50bp December hike is now on the table. SOFR futures price hikes into 2027, and Benzinga cites 99% odds of a hike at the Dec 9 meeting. Today Thorne warns Warsh against a 'reckless' 50bp move, which is opinion. The next dated catalyst is the Dec 9 FOMC. This thread has run since the 10-28 hawkish hold, and the 10-29 TLT flag graded right.

This extends the 11-09 break below $75K and the 50-week average, so the 11-05 to 11-09 downside warnings keep playing out. Exchange-failure clause: untripped. notable.headline: Fed May Be Falling Behind on Inflation, Bank of America Says, Opening the Door to a Half-Point Hike; A 50-Basis-Point Fed Hike Was Unthinkable - After CPI, Economists Can't Rule It Out
notable.read: The CPI print turned a priced-in 25bp December hike into a debate between 25bp and 50bp. The 10-year at 5% and the 2-year up 17bp hit TLT, IEF, BND, VNQ and GLD together. It continues the hawkish-hold, PCE 3.6% and 165K-payrolls thread. Today's Thorne and Wolfers pieces are commentary on the same print and add no new fact.

notable.read: A second leg down after the 11-09 break below $75K, now driven by rates and ETF outflows. No exchange failed, so the qualitative clause is untripped. Bullish calls today (Lavish, Tim Warren, reserve talk) are opinion. My past BTC flags graded mixed at 5 days, so treat this as a risk-watch item, not a forecast.
